Every product that leaves our facility is backed by rigorous testing, international certifications,
and a fully traceable quality management system.

🏅

GMP for cosmetic products — internationally recognised quality management standard

✅

Good Manufacturing Practices ensuring consistent quality at every stage

🌿

#### COSMOS

Natural and ayurvedic formulations meeting European cosmetics standards

🐰

#### Cruelty-Free

Quality Control Process
01

#### Raw Material Sourcing

Every ingredient is sourced from certified suppliers with full CoA verification and purity testing.

02

#### In-Process Testing

pH, viscosity, microbial, and stability tests are conducted at each production checkpoint.

03

#### GC-MS Analysis

Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry for essential oil purity and composition profiling.

04

#### Finished Product Release

Full panel testing, safety assessment, and documentation before every batch is dispatched.

* Steam distillation units for essential oil extraction
* Cold-chain storage for temperature-sensitive raw materials
* In-house stability testing chambers (ICH compliant)

* Dedicated export documentation and logistics team

# EXCELLENCE WITH TRADITIONS

Bulk essential oil supplier

Order samples

## A heritage that goes back three generations

Atmosphaer is an essential oil supplier and a reliable partner to your business. We supply
high-quality Bulgarian essential oils in bulk for the perfume and cosmetic industry. You can order
in large quantities and expect the best quality with every delivery. The company has significant
experience in the field that allows for precision, quality control and impeccable expertise.
Atmosphaer’ success in the industry is based on the above-mentioned experience that we’ve gathered
throughout the years. We take pride in what we do and we’ve prioritised the quality of both our
products and our customer’s current needs and requirements. To put it simply – we care. 

## Bulk essential oils

We offer essential oils in bulk.

Atmosphaer’s products have been chosen by some of the most renowned cosmetic, perfume and food
manufacturers from France, Italy, the US and the rest of the world. Both clients and IFEAT delegates
are welcome to visit Atmosphaer’s production plant and experience the magic of the production
process in person. We will be happy to have you here to show you our diligence and inspiration that
underlie each step of the way.

[ORDER SAMPLES][13]
* Lavender
* Bulgarian rose
* Melissa
* Yarrow
* Juniper berry
* Basil
* [Chamomile][Chamomile]
  Chamomile
* Geranium
[Lavender essential oil][Lavender essential oil]

## Organic essential oil supplier

We also supply organic oils of the finest quality. They are 100% pure organic material, perfect for
the production of organic cosmetics, perfumes and food. We are a certified supplier, so you can be
certain of the quality of the products. Atmosphaer observes the best practices in the production,
packaging and delivery processes to ensure compliance with the highest standards industry-wise.
Depending on the mateirial type, we use special containers for storing and transporting the material
that preserve its characteristics and ensure safe transportation.

## Buy in bulk for your business

At Atmosphaer, we believe in total transparency and this is why we guarantee the full traceability
of our products from soil to sample. Strategically located within the beautiful Rose Valley of
Bulgaria it benefits from a vast selection of rose and lavender gardens offering a lush and fresh
supply of herb and flower blossoms. Combining the best manufacturing practices and the highest
quality standards, the distillery has been producing the finest Damascena Rose oil for over 25 years
now. We are happy to be able to supply the bulk material for your business, offer competitive and
fair prices as well.

[Get in Touch][14]

## Absolute dedication to quality

Atmosphaer holds Good Manufacturing Practice certification that asserts our conscientious approach
to hygiene, sanitary and processing practices in our daily work. We meet and exceed all of the
criteria for the GMP certification because we take the safety and hygiene standards in our industry
very seriously. We are proud to say we are also REACH-compliant. We have a registration number for
the production and processing of registered substances, which we supply to our customers, so they
can also show that they comply with European regulations.

## Ethically sourced materials

We, at Atmosphaer, have made sure that the materials that we use for our products are ethically
sourced, meaning that we don’t work with vendors that implement child labour into their practices
and bad work conditions for their farmers.

We also support fair trade and aim to support small businesses – all of the supply companies that
we’ve partnered up with are given a fair price for their produce.

We believe that all of these important measures can make a huge, positive impact on the whole
industry and help the tradition live on.

## Your Trusted Essential Oils, Herbs & Nutraceuticals Products Manufacturer & Exporter in India

Bexport Hub Corporation is a certified essential oils, herbs & nutraceuticals products exporter in
Gujarat with years of profound experience in the procurement, manufacturing, and export of authentic
and organic essential oils and herb products such as mahua flower, curcumin, palmarosa oil,
lemongrass oil, vetiver oil, and calcium sennoside.
Our massive success in the international export market is the result of a streamlined procurement
process, vast network, infrastructure, and driven workforce.
Owing to our invaluable experience in the market and in-depth understanding of the medicinal
properties and health benefits of organic Indian herbs and essential oils, we have been able to
expand ourselves in the ever-competitive global arena.
[ Read More ][41]

## Why You Choose Us

We try our level best to do things differently so that we can continually become better for our
clients, our staff, and the communities.
We are also well known for our some of the best services which make us different from another one.
Such as like we provide quality products in an affordable price so all our client afford it easily.
More over we know the value of time so we are here to deliver your order on time.

## Why Join Hands with Bexport Hub?

### 100% Organic & Tested Products

As an APEDA-certified manufacturer & exporter, our essential oils and edible herbs are trusted by
our worldwide clientele.

### Focus On Innovation

Innovation is our second name and that reflects in our exceptional infrastructural and logistic
capabilities.

### Customer Satisfaction

Driven to make Indian essential oils and edible herbs accessible in the world, we have maintained a
delighted client base.

## Our products

Essential Oils

#### Essential Oils & Derivatives

[Essential Oils & Derivatives]

Essential oils are the concentrated aroma and flavor profiles extracted from the flowers, fruits,
roots, bark, leaves, and herbs of botanicals from around the world.

[image-e1761896364523.jpg]

Organics

#### Organic Oils

For more than 20 years, Berjé has partnered with Oregon Tilth to certify our growing list of organic
products. Organic essential oils have become an increasingly important commodity within the modern
flavor and fragrance industry.

[ladies-e1761900686117.jpg]

Fixed Oils

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

Upcycled Ingredients

#### Upcycled Ingredients

Berjé’s Upcycled Ingredients highlight the beauty of resource diversity and innovation at source,
embracing the sustainable, regenerative nature of our global botanicals.

Naturals

#### Natural Aromatics

Berjé offers a full range of natural aromatics and isolates – expertly sourced compounds derived
from natural materials such as plants, fruits, flowers, spices, and resins.

[farm-e1761900668825.jpg]

Aromatic Chemicals

#### Aromatic Chemicals

Flavors and fragrances stem from the art of chemistry. To complement our essential oils, Berjé
offers over 2,500 natural and synthetic aromatic chemicals.

products. Organic essential oils have become an increasingly important commodity within the modern
flavor and fragrance industry.

[ladies-e1761900686117.jpg]

Fixed Oils

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

Upcycled Ingredients

#### Upcycled Ingredients

Berjé’s Upcycled Ingredients highlight the beauty of resource diversity and innovation at source,
embracing the sustainable, regenerative nature of our global botanicals.

Naturals

#### Natural Aromatics

Berjé offers a full range of natural aromatics and isolates – expertly sourced compounds derived
from natural materials such as plants, fruits, flowers, spices, and resins.

[farm-e1761900668825.jpg]

Aromatic Chemicals

#### Aromatic Chemicals

Flavors and fragrances stem from the art of chemistry. To complement our essential oils, Berjé
offers over 2,500 natural and synthetic aromatic chemicals.

# Oils

Since our inception in the year 1990, the primary objective of BMV has been to passionately work
towards the creation of a nature friendly environment. BMV is one of the well known manufacturers,
exporters and suppliers of pure essential oils, aroma oils, perfume oils and fragrance oils across
the perfumery industry as a company true to its authenticity and values with every step marked by
creativity and innovation. BMV Fragrances believes in the power of knowledge and commitment for the
satisfaction of our customers across the globe. With a combined experience of more than 87 years and
our continuous and intensive research in the field of [**natural essential oils**][42] and
[**perfumery materials**][43] has enabled us to know our client's needs better for essential oils
and constantly strive to meet their expectations.

This fusion of knowledge, affinity towards nature and creativity has made us one of the largest
producers of essential oils, resin, [**synthetic essential oil**][44], [**reconstitutions**][45] and
[**perfumery bases**][46], perfume oils. We provide [**100% pure essential oils in wholesale**][47],
including Fragrance Oils, Perfume Oils, Aromatherapy Oils, resin manufacturing, along with
Reconstitution Oils and Specialities to different industries. Our top-quality product range has made
us an approved supplier, manufacturer, and trusted brand in wholesaling of essential oils, synthetic
essential oils, fragrance oils and [**resins manufacturer**][48].

We welcome all your requirements of 100% natural, pure & natural essential oils, [**perfume
oils**][49] and [**fragrance oils**][50]. Every single day our team of researchers and innovators
set out to bring a new variety of pure and natural or reconstitutions of oils, synthetic essential
oils, [**resinoids**][51], absolutes and [**perfumery bases**][52] to the shelves to deliver to our
valued customers. We not only make sure that we improve the variety but also maintain the highest
quality of all our products which always live beyond the expectations of our clients. We have a firm
determination to deliver the best products as per our commitments to client satisfaction.

## Nature
## serving the senses

We bring **Nature’s best** to you so that your product, like nature itself, may enliven, comfort,
nourish, heal, and delight. Since we know you are always looking for something new to offer your
clients, so are we. Our aim is to surprise, and thankfully Nature has the same objective. Nature is
constantly revealing **new ingredients, scents and flavours**. We survey landscapes, near and far,
to find Nature’s latest revelations and bring them to you.

## OUR PRODUCTSNature's best

Cedarome is a **leading, worldwide producer and supplier** of **pure and natural Essential Oils**,
notably cold pressed **Citrus Oils**, **Natural Isolates**, and **Canadian Forest Naturals**
particularly, **coniferous oils**, concretes, absolutes and resins. Our products are used in
flavour, pharmaceutical, aromatherapy, cosmetic, fine fragrance, personal care, household fragrance
and industrial cleaner industries.

# Spikenard (Jatamansi) Oil

Discovered by the Egyptologists in Cleopatra’s perfume ointment jars, spikenard has traveled from
its origin above 8,000 feet in the Himalayas across the silk routes on camel’s backs for over
millennia. Written about in the “Song of Solomon”, Jesus had his feet anointed with Spikenard by
Mary Magdelene before the Last Supper. The oil was used by Roman perfumers and the Mughal empress
Nur Jehan in her rejuvenating cosmetics preparations. Dioscordes wrote that the herb was good for
nausea, flatulent indigestion, menstrual problems, inflammations and conjunctivitis. A pungent
rhizome root with a heavy, sweet-woody, spicy-animal odor.The herb encourages sweating making it
useful in treating fevers and since it is stimulating and detoxifying, it is commonly used to treat
the early stages of illness. Infusions and decoctions are used to treat colds and coughs and other
such respiratory conditions as asthma, as well as for rheumatism. Applied externally as a poultice,
it is used on a number of different skin conditions, including eczema.Looking like a dreadlock, this
fragrant root is known as a “yogi herb”, used by yogis for millennia for it is said it increase
awareness and is traditionally used by meditators to “ground the mind”. Valued by Ayurvedic and
Himalayan physicians for its powerful sedative properties as well as for its soothing effect on the
skin and restorative effect on the hair. It is used traditionally for complexion, strength,
spasmodic hysteria, nervous convulsions, nervous headache, epilepsy, and heart palipitations. In
Ayurveda, spikenard is traditionally used in hair preparations to not only calm the mind, but to
keep hair from falling out. Its earthy, scent is said to please the earth spirits. Commonly burned
as incense among Himalayan dwellers to calm and sanctify the environment.Jatamansi oil is obtained
by steam distillation of dried rhizomes of Nardostachys jatamansi D.C.

# Welcome to Essential Oil Haven

Thank you for stopping by! My name is Emma and I’m so excited you’ve found your way to my website!

## Essential Oil Diffusers

[compact mini diffuser for travel][compact mini diffuser for travel]

A Mini Portable Diffuser

[Diffusing essential oils][75] enhances your environment by filling the room with the particular
fragrances of the essential oil or essential oil blend you’re using.

If you’re wondering whether it’s better to use an oil burner or an oil diffuser for aromatherapy,
note there is **a very important difference** between Ultrasonic essential oil diffusers vs. heat
diffusers.

Using a heat source, even when used indirectly onto the essential oils, **causes the oils to
evaporate very quickly and therefore may not be able to maximize the full healing and therapeutic
potential of the essential oil**. To ensure a gentle approach to diffusing essential oils, use an
ultrasonic, nebulizing, or [passive][76] type of oil diffuser.

## Everyday Favorite Essential Oils

individual approach to using essential oils in your everyday life and you will definitely find your
own favorite scents and uses.

  aromatherapy baths, or put on a diffuser with lavender essential oil scent as you go to sleep.
  Read more on the [Top 10 Lavender Essential Oil Benefits][77].
* **Peppermint** – So good for a variety of stomach problems including nausea or morning sickness.
  Use peppermint essential oil as an after-dinner treat!
* **Frankincense** – Amazing for anything related to skin care. Use Frankincense essential oil in
  your unscented lotions, soaps, shower gels or moisturizers! Learn more in this article here
  on [the uses and benefits of Frankincense][78] essentia

# Welcome to Essential Oil Resource Consultants

**Essential Oil Resource Consultants (EORC) are providers of research, education and information
in the field of essential oils and aromatherapy.**

With experience spanning more than three decades, EORC promotes excellence in safe and effective
essential oil use as well as striving to provide up-to-date and relevant information to all users of
essential oils.

Their expertise in clinical aromatherapy and the integration of essential oils in healthcare
settings around the world is a particular focus.

Via the International Clinical Aromatherapy Network, EORC also acts as a connecting hub for
professional aromatherapists worldwide irrespective of their affiliations to aromatherapy
organisations or schools, thereby promoting and facilitating connections, collaborations and the
evolution of professional aromatherapy around the world.

EORC is a registered company based in France and headed by [**Rhiannon Lewis**][22].

Based in the mountains of Provence, France, EORC’s reach and ongoing impact is truly international,
connecting users of essential oils around the world.

EORC accomplishes its mission of providing research, education and information in five main ways:

**Education**

**Conference Events**

**Publishing**

**Networking**

**Consultancy**

 

## Education

Through a range of online and in-person programs, Rhiannon offers a palette of evidence-based
learning opportunities as well as providing customised classes for private or public institutions…

[ Learn More ][23]

## Conferences

Through her work and extensive travels, Rhiannon has developed an extensive network of professional
connections in the scientific and aromatherapy worlds. Bringing these actors together to share their
research and passion was a natural step…

[ Learn More ][24]

## Publishing

Sharing information related to the ever-increasing evidence based for aromatherapy integration is an
essential part of EORC’s mission…

 

[ Learn More ][25]

## Networking

EORC is convinced that networking and information sharing is an essential part of healthy
aromatherapy integration.
In 2021, EORC created the International Clinical Aromatherapy Network (ICAN), the only independent
online network for all aromatherapy professionals…

[ Learn More ][26]

## Consultancy

EORC is available for consultancy on projects related to aromatherapy provision including guidance
for formulations, curriculum development, essential oil chemistry, specialist topic deep dives and
evidence gathering.

 

[ Learn More ][27]

**Do you want to keep up with EORC News and happenings?**

By opting to receive EORC News, you will receive a periodical newsletter with community insights,
latest happenings and educational snippets about aromatherapy from Rhiannon.

It will also help you to keep your finger on the pulse of any upcoming EORC-related classes and
events.

But don’t worry, your subscription won’t result in an overflowing mailbox with heavy marketing !

We appreciate your support and have a vision to keep moving aromatherapy forward.

## Healing Fragrances Aromatherapy School

Founded in 2002 by Danielle Sade, our mission is to provide the latest education on aromatherapy and
essential oils. Our students will gain a deep understanding of essential oils and an unbiased
education that eliminates misinformation. Our courses can be taken at your own pace, from anywhere
in the world. You will have unlimited access to the learning platform and one-on-one support. 

Upon graduating, you will have the knowledge to succeed at each stage of your aromatherapy journey.
Our graduates have used their knowledge and skills as a solitary vocation in clinical care, skincare
cosmetics, formulators, or have effectively integrated aromatherapy into their careers. Once you
have graduated you will become a Certified Aromatherapy Health Professional (CAHP), recognized by
the Canadian Federation of Aromatherapist. Whether you are looking to invest in your interests or
enhance your career, our courses are designed to take your knowledge to the next level.

## Healing Fragrances Aromatherapy School

Founded in 2002 by Danielle Sade, our mission is to provide the latest education on aromatherapy and
essential oils. Our students will gain a deep understanding of essential oils and an unbiased
education that eliminates misinformation. Our courses can be taken at your own pace, from anywhere
in the world. You will have unlimited access to the learning platform and one-on-one support. 

Upon graduating, you will have the knowledge to succeed at each stage of your aromatherapy journey.
Our graduates have used their knowledge and skills as a solitary vocation in clinical care, skincare
cosmetics, formulators, or have effectively integrated aromatherapy into their careers. Once you
have graduated you will become a Certified Aromatherapy Health Professional (CAHP), recognized by
the Canadian Federation of Aromatherapist. Whether you are looking to invest in your interests or
enhance your career, our courses are designed to take your knowledge to the next level.

As a second generation, family owned company, our legacy of providing quality, and unrivaled
service, has sustained Immortelle Therapy’s position as the leading manufacturer of Helichrysum
italicum, Lavender and Sage essential oils and herbs in Balkan. We are an Albanian – American
company that grows and distill the finest essential oils and hydrosol (floral waters) in the region.
Our global headquarters (Sales Office) is based in NYC. We produce 100% organic & pure and natural
raw materials for professionals working in personal care, cosmetic, perfumery, pharmaceutical and
aromatherapy and food industry. Helichrysum italicum, Lavender and Sage plants from Albania produce
high quality essential oils / herbs. Due to the Mediterranean climate, soil composition, and long
dry summers brew the perfect conditions for this plant to grow and blossom. As a result it produces
Helichicrysum italicum, Lavender and Sage essential oils, which is well-balanced in all key
ingredients.

The Immortelle, Lavender and Sage that we grow is the Helichrysum italicum, Lavandula angustifolia
and Salvia Officinalis species that is native to the Mediterranean region. We source our seeds from
natural occurring Immortelle and Sage that is found in the wild in Albania, which is known to
produce the highest quality helichrysum italicum, Lavender and Sage essential oils and herbs. The
plantations are surrounded with untouched nature, mountains, grasslands and meadows, without
influence from agricultural mono-cultures or other pollutants. Our plantations are supervised by
experts. The Helichrysum Italicum, Lavender and Sage plants are hand-planted and 100% organically
grown without any use of pesticides, fertilizers, fungicides, watering or any stimulatory
supplements. Great geo-location, Mediterranean climate, karst terrain and driven dedication to work
are guarantees of quality for our products.

The extraction method we use is steam distillation. This method complies with all environmental
standards with respect to the original state of the plant. Employing modern technology in
distillation ensures the highest quality oil extract while preserving all of the fragile chemical
constituents of the plant. We produce our essential oils products according to the highest standard
of quality, purity, and safety used in the industry. From harvested wild seeds, to cultivating the
Helichrsysum italicum, Lavender and Sage plants and the distillation practice we are part of the
whole production process. Thought dedication and unique craftsmanship of our staff, we pledges to
produce 100% organic and pure Helichrysum italicum , Lavender and Sage essential oils and Herbs.

Oils, Carrier Oils, Mint Oils and Floral Absolutes on a large scale. The company has two

Mantri Oil, Valerian Root Oil, etc. and other unit is in Mandsaur (Madhya Pradesh) for manufacturing
of Herbal Extracts and Oleoresins.

##### Our Story

## WHO WE ARE

Kush Aroma Exports was founded in 1962 as the trusted natural essential oils manufacturer, exporter,
supplier and wholesaler. We adopted the natural essential oils field to keep the ancient philosophy
alive of making a balance among body, mind and soul. Our clear perception is to represent the
nature’s 100% pure and finest range of products in front of the world. Kush Aroma Exports is the
leading essential oils manufacturer you can choose to avail 100% pure and natural essential oils
that are carefully extracted at well-equipped distillation plant in Kannauj, India. The range we
provide is prepared from fresh picked flowers by following steam distillation method. We are
renowned as the popular essential oils suppliers which also process an unadulterated range of cold
pressed carrier oil, peppermint products, traditional Indian attars, floral water and other allied
products.

## Elevate Your Journey

[Picture]
Provisions for Summiting Your Peak

## GAIA

## Earth Goddess

*The ancestral mother of all life, bearer of mountains and rivers; sky and sea,
Gaia represents the synergistic systems of energy rooted in organic grace.*
From a small fishing community in Alaska, to the rugged peaks of Colorado I now call home, my life
journey has been defined by subsistence, persistence, adventure, and connections. The ebb and flow
of my interactions with diversely beautiful environments and associated people have navigated my
course to live receptively with intention and gratitude. 

As a mother, my greatest hope for my children is that they will be the balance of both my influence
as supporter, teacher, and lover of the natural world, and their internal compass; that they will be
grounded by humility, yet take risks to rise and shine beyond the restricting world of boxes in
which we live.

**Mountain Gaia** exists as a resource along what can feel like a twisted trail of chaos to a
nourishing path rooted with resources to support your active lifestyle. We'll share tips and tricks
for adventuring outdoors, inspiration for getting out the door in the first place, as well as
anecdotal education for proactive health along the way. Embrace your journey!

Elevate Life!
[Picture]




**

Annie Thompson,* A Mountain Mama*
“The love of wilderness is more than a hunger for what is always beyond reach; it is also an
expression of loyalty to the earth, the earth which bore us and sustains us, the only paradise we
shall ever know, the only paradise we ever need...” 
~*Edward Abbey*

I share practical, evidence-informed approaches to health, skin, and everyday wellbeing, with a
focus on natural methods that actually make sense in real life.

My work bridges traditional wisdom and modern science, helping you understand how ingredients,
habits, and daily choices affect the body, the skin, and overall wellbeing.

Everything here is grounded, thoughtful, and designed to support informed, sustainable choices, not
quick fixes or extremes.

#### **My Journey**

I’ve always been passionate about **natural health and beauty**. But like many, I started out
feeling lost and very confused by all the skincare advice out there as well as frustrated with
commercial products that just didn’t feel right for me.
Over time I realised that **nature already provides everything we need** for healthy, glowing skin.
So I started learning, experimenting, and eventually became a **certified organic skincare
formulator and health coach**. Now I’m sharing what I’m learning with all of you.

#### Why this Site

I created this space for people who are **curious about natural health and care but don’t know where
to start**. It’s for those who want **simple, effective, plant-based solutions** without the
overwhelm.
I’ve spent years researching and formulating skincare, and I know how hard it is to find **reliable,
no-fluff information**. So, I built this site to be:
**Practical**, honest, accessible.
This isn’t just another health and natural beauty blog (hopefully) but a space you can trust, learn
from and experiment.

#### Expect a lot!

Here’s what you’ll find: DIY skincare recipes, ingredient guides, skincare tips, natural beauty and
wellness articles, essential oils, aromatherapy, herbal remedies and more!
My articles are hopefully easy to digest and also easy to follow. I try my best but I understand
sometimes you might need information in a particular way. I try to cater for everyone, from the
beginner to the seasoned enthusiast. I really hope you learn and follow and enjoy and grow!

# Welcome to A New Hope Educational Services!


Back in 2007, we were living in Flint, Michigan, cleaning toilets (literally), raising four kids,
and trying to stretch $11,000 a year into enough for a family of six. Spoiler: it didn’t stretch. We
were sick, tired, broke, out of shape, and desperate for something better. Then a friend handed us a
bottle of essential oils. Honestly? I rolled my eyes. But that little bottle cracked the door wide
open and gave us what we now call A New Hope Educational Services.


What started as “eh, we’ll see if this works” turned into a full-blown lifestyle shift. Now, almost
two decades later, we’ve had the privilege of walking alongside thousands of people as they step
into wellness, purpose, and abundance. And if I have anything to say about it, you’ll be next.

##  

## Our Mission

Here’s the truth → your past doesn’t get to boss your future around. Not your health history, not
your empty bank account, not that voice in your head that says you’re too far gone. Nope. You were
created to live a vibrant, extraordinary life. And if you hang around here long enough, I’m going to
make sure you start believing that too.


This space is about real talk, belly laughs, nerdy science, and practical tools that actually work.
If you want fluffy fairy dust, you’re in the wrong place. But if you want straight-up wisdom mixed
with sass and soul, pull up a chair.

People keep telling me, “Shannon, you’ve got to narrow it down. Pick ONE passion so you draw the
right people.”


Ummm… nope. Not happening. I’m passionate about a lot of things, and I pray that list keeps growing.

about teaching you how to support your beautiful breasts. Prevention, awareness, lifestyle choices,
natural tools, I want women (and men, because yes, men have breast tissue too) to feel empowered,
educated, and proactive about protecting this part of their health.


### Hormones

Hormones run the whole show, whether you like it or not. They can make you feel amazing or turn life
into a circus where the monkeys are running wild. I am passionate about helping both men and women
understand their hormones in plain, simple language. I’ll teach you how to balance them, support
them, and stop letting those little chemical messengers call all the shots. From perimenopause to
testosterone dips, thyroid struggles to adrenal fatigue, we break down the science and offer simple,
sustainable tools that help you feel like yourself again.


### Helping Mommas

I am insanely passionate as a doula about helping mommas, from getting pregnant, to staying
pregnant, to raising healthy, strong children. And here’s the kicker: I don’t want you just to
survive motherhood, I want you to feel amazing while you do it. Birth, postpartum, motherhood, these
are sacred seasons, and my heart beats to make sure women walk through them with confidence,
support, and joy.

Oh my goodness, this lights me up. There are simply not enough people teaching on relationships.
Brian and I have been happily married since 1988, he is my spark, my best friend, my partner in

reignite connection, rebuild intimacy, and remember why they fell in love in the first place.
Because sometimes that flame flickers, but it doesn’t have to go out.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Do you ship worldwide?

Yes, we ship to over 200 countries via Sea (FCL/LCL), Air Cargo, Express (DHL/UPS), or Rail.

Can I get samples before bulk order?

Yes. You can add a single item to your procurement list as a sample request. We will consolidate
samples from multiple factories to save shipping costs.

Can you source custom products (OEM)?

Absolutely. Send us your design drawings or technical requirements, and we will find a qualified
factory to manufacture it for you.

## Our Company

In the year 1968, under the stewardship of Mr. Pravinchandra B Shah, Vipul Group of companies began
its Napthol, Fast color bases and dye intermediates business. What began as a small venture,
expanded at a rapid pace and set up its manufacturing facility at Thane, outskirts of Mumbai.

Vipul Dye Chem was established in 1972, which was later renamed **Vipul Organics Limited**, to
reflect the product portfolio in the year 2017. Vipul Organics Limited is celebrating its Golden
Jubilee and is "50 years young" in the Color Industry.

In 1989, the second generation of the promoters, Mr. Vipul P Shah, joined the company, after
completing his Chemical Engineering. He was the one who really gave wings to the company's growth
story. **Vipul Organics** now also ventured into the pigments segment, making it a holistic Dyes and
Pigments company that has one-stop products and solutions for anything to do with the category.
